rounds.title: The VIP Preview
rounds.brief: Our top client, Mrs. Arora, asks for a private preview of the new Aurora collection this Saturday at 6 p.m. at the flagship store. The public launch is next Thursday. Decide by 2 p.m.

A.label: Yes, full preview
A.text: All 40 Aurora pieces, Saturday 6 p.m., her full guest list.

B.label: Yes, but smaller
B.text: Saturday, 1 hour, the 12 pieces already in our vault, phones checked at the door.

C.label: Another date
C.text: Invite her to a private first look on Wednesday, the night before launch.

D.label: Polite no
D.text: Keep the launch plan. Offer her a seat at the launch.

cards.text: Flagship can host 15 guests max in the private salon.
Last VIP night ran 30 minutes late. Staff left at 10 p.m.
Security firm needs 24 hours' notice for extra guards. Cost: $1,500.
cards.title: Security notice

cards.text: Courier from HQ: the other 28 Aurora pieces arrive Friday 11 p.m. Delays happened twice this year.
cards.title: Courier schedule

cards.text: 12 Aurora pieces are already in the flagship vault. Value: $1.1M.
Full Aurora collection: 40 pieces, value $3.4M.
Mrs. Arora's last 3 purchases were all necklaces.
cards.title: Client purchase history

cards.text: A rival brand is planning a private event for Mrs. Arora next week.
cards.title: Market chatter

cards.text: Mrs. Arora spent $1.2M with us in the last 3 years.
Event budget left this quarter: $8,000.
Insurance covers up to $2M of pieces out of the vault at one time.
cards.title: Insurance limits

cards.text: Raising insurance cover takes 48 hours and costs $9,000.
cards.title: Extra insurance

cards.text: Saturday: 2 of 6 senior advisors are on approved leave.
Overtime cap: max 3 senior advisors can work Saturday night.
Rule of thumb: 1 senior advisor per 4 VIP guests.
cards.title: Staffing ratio

cards.text: Staff say last-minute VIP nights hurt morale.
cards.title: Staff mood

cards.text: Press embargo: no Aurora photos in public before next Thursday.
Launch event next Thursday: 80 guests and press.
Our partner magazine has the exclusive first story on Aurora.
cards.title: Media deal

cards.text: Mrs. Arora's friends love posting private events online.
cards.title: Social media check

stakeholders.name: Mrs. Arora's assistant
stakeholders.text: She wants to choose a necklace for her daughter's wedding next month, before anyone else sees the collection.

stakeholders.name: Flagship store manager (12 years)
stakeholders.text: Small previews work. Big ones leak photos. 12 pieces is plenty for a buyer like her.

stakeholders.name: Regional Director
stakeholders.text: She is a friend of our CEO. Keep her happy, but do not break the launch.

stakeholders.name: Insurance broker
stakeholders.text: Your cap is $2M out of the vault. More cover needs 48 hours.

stakeholders.name: PR agency
stakeholders.text: Any leaked photo breaks our magazine deal.

breaking_news.text: Courier: the HQ shipment is delayed to Sunday.

A: Somehow it worked. Nothing leaked. Pure luck.
Pieces did not arrive, insurance gap, a photo leaked.
B: She bought a $180k necklace and asked to be first at launch.
A guest posted a blurry photo. PR had to step in.
C: She loved the Wednesday first look and bought two pieces.
She felt brushed off and bought from a rival.
D: She came to the launch and was happy.
She told the CEO she felt ignored.

rounds.title: The Late Shipment
rounds.brief: Only 600 of 1,000 units of the holiday line arrive on time. Decide how to allocate them to 12 stores and online by 12 noon.

A.label: Equal split
A.text: Same number to every store and online.

B.label: Follow the sales
B.text: 80% to the top 5 stores and online, by last year's holiday sales.

C.label: Protect VIPs first
C.text: Hold 150 units for VIP pre-orders at the flagship, the rest by last year's sales.

D.label: Delay the launch
D.text: Wait 2 weeks for the full 1,000 units.

trap.text: Supplier Velta Gems: we can deliver the missing 400 units in 5 days if you sign a 3-year exclusive contract for all Classic lines. Value: $6.5M. Answer in 2 hours.
trap.label: NO WAY BACK
trap.authority_card: Contracts over $1M need the CEO and Legal.

cards.text: Moving stock between stores later costs $25 per unit and takes 3 days.
Online orders ship from the central warehouse in 1 day.
Holiday temp staff are hired for the top 5 stores only.
cards.title: Temp staff plan

cards.text: The Riverside Mall store expects a big corporate order.
cards.title: Store chatter

cards.text: 600 units arrive today. The other 400 arrive in 4 weeks, after the holidays.
Last holiday, the top 5 stores and online sold 72% of this line. 4 small stores sold under 20 units each.
cards.title: Last holiday sales

cards.text: Unsold holiday stock after Dec 31 goes to 30% off.
cards.title: Markdown rule

cards.text: Flagship VIP waitlist: 40 pre-orders from the Aurora preview.
Average price: $850 per unit. Margin: 62%.
Contract approval: Regional Director up to $500k. Over $1M: CEO and Legal.
Every week of delay in the holiday season loses about $140k in sales.
cards.title: Cost of delay

cards.text: Velta Gems may have money problems next year.
cards.title: Supplier gossip

cards.text: Store teams are tired after the Aurora launch.
Temp staff contracts start in 10 days.
Small stores can share 1 advisor between them in December.
cards.title: Advisor sharing

cards.text: Small-store teams will be upset if they get less stock.
cards.title: Team mood

cards.text: The holiday campaign is paid and starts in 10 days. Dates cannot move.
The campaign sends customers to online and the top 5 stores.
Last year, out-of-stock online cost us 2,000 visitors a day.
cards.title: Online stock-outs

cards.text: An influencer says an equal split looks fairer to customers.
cards.title: Influencer view

cards.text: After Saturday, Mrs. Arora told two friends the preview felt chaotic.

stakeholders.name: Regional Director
stakeholders.text: I can approve the allocation. A supplier contract that size is not mine. Take it to the CEO.

stakeholders.name: Store operations lead
stakeholders.text: Small stores barely sell this line in December.

stakeholders.name: Legal
stakeholders.text: Never sign an exclusive deal in 2 hours.

stakeholders.name: Velta Gems sales rep
stakeholders.text: Other brands want this slot. Decide fast.

stakeholders.name: Top store manager
stakeholders.text: Give my store more. We always sell out.

wrong: Number of stores that got stock

A: Sales were fine, but small stores kept stock into January.
Top stores sold out in a week. Small stores sat on stock.
B: A mall flood closed one top store for a week.
C: VIPs got their pieces. Sales were strong.
Some VIPs cancelled. 30 units waited at the flagship.
D: The full line launched late but sold well.
The paid campaign ran with empty shelves.

carry.rule: by R1 choice, never by luck

small_call.text: Can two small stores share one advisor in December? I need a yes or no today.

escalate.reply: Regional Director: That's your call. You don't need me for this.

quality_v2.evidence: -1 if no critical or key card matches the chosen option
quality_v2.rumor: -1 only if a rumor is the only evidence
quality_v2.measure: -1 if the measure does not fit
quality_v2.defended: +1 by host when the rationale makes a fair case (max 5)

trust_v2.call_fatigue: calls 3 and up get shorter, irritated replies

scoring.speed_note: only the main stamp sets Speed. The trap and the small call do not change Speed, only the time they cost.
announce_upfront: Ask the right people, not everyone
Every report and call costs time

table_rules.leader: cos if present, else rotates each round
table_rules.note: cos holds no data: owns the stamp, the clock view and the rationale draft

players.store: nickname only, deleted after the session

phone_only: stakeholder calls (phone filter, low volume, text always shown)
